12. The Silence of the Woods
The Fermi Paradox asks where all the aliens are; one terrifying answer suggests they are all hiding. In this model, the universe is a _________where every civilization is an armed hunter stalking through the trees, and the only way to survive is to remain silent and eliminate anyone who makes a sound. By broadcasting our location for a century, we may have simply invited a predator we cannot see. What is the name of this theory? ‎

Manas, quick thought on the trivia questions you’ve been sharing.
I think the intent of the group is to have questions where people can engage, think, and deduce their way to an answer - even if they don’t know it immediately. Lately, some of the questions (like today’s) feel extremely niche/obscure, to the point where it’s almost impossible to even make an educated guess.
That takes away from the fun a bit, because it becomes less about reasoning and more about whether someone has randomly come across that exact fact before.
Would be great if you could frame questions that have some logical entry point - clues, context, or something people can build on - so more of us can participate meaningfully.
Just sharing this so the group stays engaging for everyone 👍
